name: Acetyl-α-methylfentanyl
summary: α-Methylacetylfentanyl (or alphamethylacetylfentanyl) is an opioid analgesic and an analog of fentanyl. It is classified as a Schedule I controlled substance in many jurisdictions.

pharmacology.text: Pharmacologically, α-methylacetylfentanyl acts as a mu-opioid receptor agonist and produces effects similar to those of fentanyl.

sideEffects.text: The adverse effects of fentanyl analogs are also similar to those of fentanyl itself, including itching, nausea, and severe respiratory depression, which may be life-threatening.
